cohort: Healthy mothers with diamniotic twin pregnancies and no chronic diseases or gestational complications
finding: Both autologous and heterologous ART conceptions were associated with increased odds of operative delivery compared to spontaneous conception, while only autologous ART was linked to a higher risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: This study found that both autologous and heterologous ART conception were associated with increased odds of operative delivery in diamniotic twin pregnancies, even in healthy mothers with no chronic diseases or gestational complications.
